intent: Analyze system state baseline for HP Omen 30L
detected_fault: Random shutdowns, corrupted game files, and inconsistent RAM usage
suggested_solution: Run memtest86 to rule out memory issues.
Reinstall Windows 11 and update all drivers, including AMD GPU drivers.
Test games for continued issues after driver updates.
Consider replacing the SSD if its health is below 90-100%.
Swap back to original RAM sticks to see if issue persists.
